patch.summary: monday.com migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to monday.com by inventorying legacy project-management fields, mapping them to monday.com objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Paid plans enforce a 3-seat minimum — solo/micro teams pay for unused seats
Success signal: task boards works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: monday.com migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power task boards, timeline / Gantt, workload and resources and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into monday.com; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Slack; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Teams standardising on one Work OS for projects, ops and cross-functional work outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Paid plans enforce a 3-seat minimum — solo/micro teams pay for unused seats
If monday.com mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Hive before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Slack in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Paid plans enforce a 3-seat minimum — solo/micro teams pay for unused seats

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: AI credits are bundled/paid extras that raise effective TCO beyond the seat floor

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Free plan caps seats (2) and boards (3)

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for task boards
Mitigate: Paid plans enforce a 3-seat minimum — solo/micro teams pay for unused seats
